newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil weakens.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil weakens.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Tuesday, with gas oil weaker on easier futures and naphtha stronger on short-covering, traders said.
Gas oil shed about $2 on futures. Premiums were steady, with new French and German heating oil and low sulphur diesel demand.
Naphtha prices strengthened by around $10 a tonne boosted by trader short covering, signs of fresh end-user demand and transatlantic arbitrage possibilities.
High sulphur cracked fuel oil was firmer and barges traded up to $119 fob ARA. Low sulphur fuel was soft.
